name: EXM_EXPENSE_REPORTS
description: This table contains the general information for expense reports, such as the report number, purpose of the report, and the person on the expense report.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense report.

columns.name: AUDIT_PRIOR_MGR_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Expense report approval status when expense auditor audits an expense report before manager approvals are complete.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of payment for this expense report such as check, cash, or credit.

columns.name: PARENT_EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the parent expense report.

columns.name: PREPARER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person who created the expense report.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person whose expenses are included in this expense report.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the assignment of the person on the expense report.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_DATE
columns.description: Month, day, and year in which an expense report is saved or submitted.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_TOTAL
columns.description: Total amount of the expense report in reimbursement currency. Amount in approver preferred currency is also shown if approver has a different preferred currency.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_NUM
columns.description: Unique number that references an expense report and follows the numbering policies of the company.

columns.name: PURPOSE
columns.description: Business activities that justify the expense report.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the amount to be reimbursed to the individual for the expenses incurred.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for calculating the reimbursable amount.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person chosen as the initial approver by the individual.

columns.name: CURRENT_APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the current approver of the expense report.

columns.name: AWT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Alternate tax withholding group identifier.

columns.name: UNAPPLIED_ADVANCES_JUST
columns.description: Justification for not applying an outstanding cash advance against this expense report.

columns.name: REPORT_SUBMIT_DATE
columns.description: Month, day, and year in which an expense report is submitted.

columns.name: EXPENSE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Expense report approval status, such as Approved, Pending Manager Approval, or Paid.

columns.name: EXPENSE_STATUS_DATE
columns.description: Date when expense report acquired the current status.

columns.name: EXP_REP_PROCESSING_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the details of expense report, such as report status change history.

columns.name: RECEIPTS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Receipt status of an expense report, such as Missing, Required, and Received.

columns.name: RECEIPTS_FILING_NUMBER
columns.description: Receipt filing number that is manually entered by the expense auditor.

columns.name: RECEIPTS_RECEIVED_DATE
columns.description: Date when receipts for the expense report are received.

columns.name: HOLDING_EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the expense report that is on payment hold, thereby preventing the reimbursement of this expense report.

columns.name: AUDIT_CODE
columns.description: Audit type for the expense report based on receipt requirements, such as original receipt-based audit and imaged receipt-based audit.

columns.name: LAST_AUDIT_BY
columns.description: Person identifier of the expense auditor who previously audited the expense report.

columns.name: AUDIT_RETURN_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason why the expense report was returned to the individual during audit.

columns.name: SHORTPAY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicator of why the expense report is short paid.

columns.name: BOTHPAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether the expense report contains corporate card transactions with Both Pay payment liability.

columns.name: EXPORT_REJECT_CODE
columns.description: Reason for the rejection of the expense report by the payment request creation process.

columns.name: EXPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a specific instance of the expense reimbursement process that processed this report.

columns.name: FINAL_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.description: Date when final approval is obtained.

columns.name: CASH_EXPENSE_PAID_DATE
columns.description: Date when cash expense was reimbursed to the individual.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Human workflow composite identifier of the approval notification.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: IMAGED_RECEIPTS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the imaged receipts for an expense report, such as Required, Missing, and Received.

columns.name: IMAGED_RECEIPTS_RECEIVED_DATE
columns.description: Date when an imaged receipt is received for an expense report.

columns.name: MISSING_IMAGES_REASON
columns.description: Reason imaged receipts are not submitted with the expense report.

columns.name: OVERDUE_RCPT_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Human workflow composite identifier of the overdue receipt notification.

columns.name: PAYMENT_HOLD_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Human workflow composite identifier of the expense report payment hold notification.

columns.name: APPLY_CASH_ADV_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator of whether available cash advances are applied to this expense report.

columns.name: UNAPPLIED_CASH_ADV_REASON
columns.description: Reason outstanding cash advances are not applied to this expense report.

columns.name: TRIP_ID
columns.description: Business trip for which report was created.

columns.name: REPORT_CREATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of expense report creation, such as mobile iOS device or mobile Android device.

columns.name: SPLIT_ALLOCATION_SET_ID
columns.description: Specific split allocation set identifier.

columns.name: AUDIT_RULES_SNAPSHOT
columns.description: Audit rules configured by customer

columns.name: CASH_ADV_APPLIED_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of applying cash advances to expenses. Possible values are from the EXM_ENABLE_APPLY_ADVANCES lookup-Manual,Automatic

columns.name: CA_REVERSAL_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the last reverted cash advances that were associated with an expense report. The Group ID is NULL for cash advances applied to the report.

columns.name: CA_BANNER_DISPLAY_CODE
columns.description: Identifier to check whether to display cash advance adjusted, removed, withdrawn, or shortpaid message in the banner.
